elements.label: Figure 9.1
elements.title: Data visualization techniques can involve collecting and analyzing geospatial data, such as measurements collected by the National Park Service during the High-Efficiency Trail Assessment Process (HETAP).
elements.details: Photo showing people in a forest setting with specialized bicycles and a device on the ground, presumably for collecting geospatial data. The image credit notes modification of work 'Trail Accessibility Assessments' by GlacierNPS/Flickr, Public Domain.
elements.summary: This image illustrates the practical application of data visualization techniques in collecting and analyzing geospatial data in natural environments, highlighting the use of specialized equipment during the High-Efficiency Trail Assessment Process.
